title: “I Betray Others” or “Others Betray Me”
synopsis: Cao Cao kills an innocent family after mistakenly believing they are plotting against him.

fullText.simplified:
“我负人”还是“人负我”

    曹操年轻的时候去杀一个叫董卓的大坏人，但被董卓发现了。还好他聪明，一被发现就跑了。
    曹操往南边跑，他的老家在南边。一路上都有董卓的人，他们都在找曹操。虽然他们不认识曹操，但他们不放过每一个从北方来的人。在经过一个小城市时，曹操被发现了。因为他是从北方来的，所以被关了起来。
    这个小城市的市长叫陈宫。他问曹操：“你是谁？为什么从北方来这儿？”
    曹操说：“我是一个在北方工作的商人，要回南边的家。”
    陈宫说：“不对，你是曹操，我在北方见过你。”
    曹操不记得以前见过陈宫了，他很害怕，问：“你要杀我吗？还是把我送给董卓？”
    陈宫说：“你是好人，做了我想做的事，我不会杀你。”
    陈宫和曹操是一样的人，他也想杀大坏人董卓。他放了曹操，还和曹操一起走了。他想先跟曹操一起回老家，然后再想办法回北方杀董卓。
    他们不吃不睡地走了几天，累极了。这天，他们经过一个老人的家。这个老人是曹操爸爸的朋友。老人很好，让曹操和陈宫在他家睡觉。家里没有好酒好菜，老人就去买酒买菜。
    晚上，正在睡觉的曹操听到老人的两个家人在外面说话。
    一个人问：“真的要杀吗？”
    一个人说：“杀！”
    曹操觉得这两个人想杀他，就马上拿起刀，去外面把他们杀了。家里其他人发现曹操在杀人，都害怕地大叫起来，曹操又把他们也杀了。杀完人，曹操看到房间外面有一只猪，才知道自己杀错人了。那两个人说的“杀”是杀猪，不是杀曹操。杀猪是为了给曹操做菜吃。
    但人已经杀了，没有办法了。曹操和陈宫马上离开了老人家。
    离开的路上，他们遇到了买酒回来的老人。老人笑着问：“我买了好酒，你们怎么就要走了？”曹操不说话，拿起刀，把老人也杀了。
    陈宫大叫：“你为什么杀他？”
    曹操说：“他回家以后，就会发现我杀了他的家人，然后一定会马上去告诉董卓的人，要他们来杀我。现在我杀了他，就不会有这些事了。”
    陈宫生气极了：“你这样做，和董卓有什么不同呢？”
    曹操说：“宁教我负天下人，休教天下人负我！”他的意思是，虽然我杀错了人，但那是因为我不想让他们有机会来杀我。我能做对不起别人的事，但别人不能做对不起我的事。
    陈宫说不出话来，他不想和曹操一起走了，他离开了曹操。
    曹操又是一个人了，但他觉得自己没有错。
fullText.traditional:
“我負人”還是“人負我”

    曹操年輕的時候去殺一個叫董卓的大壞人，但被董卓發現了。還好他聰明，一被發現就跑了。
    曹操往南邊跑，他的老家在南邊。一路上都有董卓的人，他們都在找曹操。雖然他們不認識曹操，但他們不放過每一個從北方來的人。在經過一個小城市時，曹操被發現了。因為他是從北方來的，所以被關了起來。
    這個小城市的市長叫陳宮。他問曹操：“你是誰？為什麼從北方來這兒？”
    曹操說：“我是一個在北方工作的商人，要回南邊的家。”
    陳宮說：“不對，你是曹操，我在北方見過你。”
    曹操不記得以前見過陳宮了，他很害怕，問：“你要殺我嗎？還是把我送給董卓？”
    陳宮說：“你是好人，做了我想做的事，我不會殺你。”
    陳宮和曹操是一樣的人，他也想殺大壞人董卓。他放了曹操，還和曹操一起走了。他想先跟曹操一起回老家，然後再想辦法回北方殺董卓。
    他們不吃不睡地走了幾天，累極了。這天，他們經過一個老人的家。這個老人是曹操爸爸的朋友。老人很好，讓曹操和陳宮在他家睡覺。家裡沒有好酒好菜，老人就去買酒買菜。
    晚上，正在睡覺的曹操聽到老人的兩個家人在外面說話。
    一個人問：“真的要殺嗎？”
    一個人說：“殺！”
    曹操覺得這兩個人想殺他，就馬上拿起刀，去外面把他們殺了。家裡其他人發現曹操在殺人，都害怕地大叫起來，曹操又把他們也殺了。殺完人，曹操看到房間外面有一隻豬，才知道自己殺錯人了。那兩個人說的“殺”是殺豬，不是殺曹操。殺豬是為了給曹操做菜吃。
    但人已經殺了，沒有辦法了。曹操和陳宮馬上離開了老人家。
    離開的路上，他們遇到了買酒回來的老人。老人笑著問：“我買了好酒，你們怎麼就要走了？”曹操不說話，拿起刀，把老人也殺了。
    陳宮大叫：“你為什麼殺他？”
    曹操說：“他回家以後，就會發現我殺了他的家人，然後一定會馬上去告訴董卓的人，要他們來殺我。現在我殺了他，就不會有這些事了。”
    陳宮生氣極了：“你這樣做，和董卓有什麼不同呢？”
    曹操說：“寧教我負天下人，休教天下人負我！”他的意思是，雖然我殺錯了人，但那是因為我不想讓他們有機會來殺我。我能做對不起別人的事，但別人不能做對不起我的事。
    陳宮說不出話來，他不想和曹操一起走了，他離開了曹操。
    曹操又是一個人了，但他覺得自己沒有錯。

sentences.simplified: 现在我杀了他，就不会有这些事了。”
sentences.traditional: 現在我殺了他，就不會有這些事了。”
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài wǒ shā le tā jiù bú huì yǒu zhè xiē shì le
sentences.english: .. and then he will definitely go immediately to tell Dong Zhuo’s men to come and kill me.”
“Now that I’ve killed him, none of that will happen.”

sentences.simplified: 陈宫生气极了：“你这样做，和董卓有什么不同呢？”
sentences.traditional: 陳宮生氣極了：“你這樣做，和董卓有什麼不同呢？”
sentences.pinyin: chén gōng shēng qì jí le nǐ zhè yàng zuò hé dǒng zhuó yǒu shén me bù tóng ne

sentences.english: Chen Gong was extremely angry: “By doing this, how are you any different from Dong Zhuo?”

sentences.simplified: 曹操说：“宁教我负天下人，休教天下人负我！”
sentences.traditional: 曹操說：“寧教我負天下人，休教天下人負我！”
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo shuō nìng jiào wǒ fù tiān xià rén xiū jiào tiān xià rén fù wǒ

sentences.simplified: 他的意思是，虽然我杀错了人，但那是因为我不想让他们有机会来杀我。
sentences.traditional: 他的意思是，雖然我殺錯了人，但那是因為我不想讓他們有機會來殺我。
sentences.pinyin: tā de yì si shì suī rán wǒ shā cuò le rén dàn nà shì yīn wèi wǒ bù xiǎng ràng tā men yǒu jī huì lái shā wǒ
sentences.english: Cao Cao said, “I would rather betray the world than let the world betray me!”

sentences.simplified: 我能做对不起别人的事，但别人不能做对不起我的事。
sentences.traditional: 我能做對不起別人的事，但別人不能做對不起我的事。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ néng zuò duì bu qǐ bié ren de shì dàn bié ren bù néng zuò duì bu qǐ wǒ de shì
sentences.english: What he meant was that although he had killed people mistakenly, it was because he did not want to give them the chance to kill him.
I may do things that wrong others, but others must not do things that wrong me.

sentences.simplified: 陈宫说不出话来，他不想和曹操一起走了，他离开了曹操。
sentences.traditional: 陳宮說不出話來，他不想和曹操一起走了，他離開了曹操。
sentences.pinyin: chén gōng shuō bù chū huà lái tā bù xiǎng hé cáo cāo yì qǐ zǒu le tā lí kāi le cáo cāo

sentences.english: Chen Gong was left speechless. He no longer wished to go with Cao Cao, so he parted ways with him.

sentences.simplified: 曹操又是一个人了，但他觉得自己没有错。
sentences.traditional: 曹操又是一個人了，但他覺得自己沒有錯。
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo yòu shì yí ge rén le dàn tā jué de zì jǐ méi yǒu cuò

sentence_translations: “I Betray Others” or “Others Betray Me”
When Cao Cao was young, he went to kill a great villain named Dong Zhuo, but he was discovered by Dong Zhuo.
Fortunately, he was clever, and as soon as he was discovered, he ran away.
Cao Cao fled south, since his hometown was in the south.
Along the way, there were men of Dong Zhuo everywhere, all searching for Cao Cao.
Although they did not know Cao Cao, they did not let anyone coming from the north slip by.
When passing through a small city, Cao Cao was discovered. Because he had come from the north, he was locked up.
The mayor of this small city was named Chen Gong.
He asked Cao Cao, “Who are you? Why have you come here from the north?”
Cao Cao said, “I’m a merchant working in the north, and I’m on my way back to my home in the south.”
Chen Gong said, “No, you’re Cao Cao. I’ve seen you in the north before.”
Cao Cao did not remember previously meeting Chen Gong.
He was very afraid and asked, “Are you going to kill me? Or are you going to hand me over to Dong Zhuo?”
Chen Gong said, “You are a good person. You are doing what I want to do. I will not kill you.”
Chen Gong was the same kind of person as Cao Cao; he too wanted to kill the great villain, Dong Zhuo.
He released Cao Cao and even went with him on his way.
He wanted to first go with Cao Cao back to his hometown, and then think of a way to return north to kill Dong Zhuo.
They walked for several days without eating or sleeping, and were extremely tired.
That day, they passed by an old man’s house. This old man was a friend of Cao Cao’s father.
The old man was very kind and let Cao Cao and Chen Gong sleep at his house.
There was no good wine or food at home, so the old man went to buy wine and food.
At night, while Cao Cao was sleeping, he heard two of the old man’s family members talking outside.
One person asked, “Do we really have to kill?”
One person said, “Kill!”
Cao Cao thought these two people wanted to kill him, so he immediately picked up his sword and went outside to kill them.
When the other family members saw Cao Cao killing people, they cried out in fear, and Cao Cao killed them as well.
After he finished killing, Cao Cao saw a pig outside the room and only then realized he had killed people mistakenly.
What these two people had meant by “kill” was killing the pig, not killing Cao Cao.
They were going to kill the pig to prepare a meal for Cao Cao.
But the people had already been killed, and there was nothing that could be done.
Cao Cao and Chen Gong immediately left the old man’s house.
On their way out, they ran into the old man who was returning with the wine he had bought.
Smiling, the old man asked, “I’ve bought good wine. Why are you leaving already?”
Cao Cao said nothing; he picked up his sword and killed the old man as well.
Chen Gong shouted, “Why did you kill him?”
Cao Cao said, “After he returns home, he will find out that I killed his family, ..
.. and then he will definitely go immediately to tell Dong Zhuo’s men to come and kill me.”
“Now that I’ve killed him, none of that will happen.”
Chen Gong was extremely angry: “By doing this, how are you any different from Dong Zhuo?”
Cao Cao said, “I would rather betray the world than let the world betray me!”
What he meant was that although he had killed people mistakenly, it was because he did not want to give them the chance to kill him.
I may do things that wrong others, but others must not do things that wrong me.
Chen Gong was left speechless. He no longer wished to go with Cao Cao, so he parted ways with him.
Cao Cao was alone once again, but he felt he had done nothing wrong.
